shape.appetite: One new view type covering every field type with a small set of intentional cell kinds (scatter, jitter, correlation, box, count tiles, stacked bars; density/histogram/bar diagonals), one group color, one brush, and trace.
shape.problem: Users facing unfamiliar multivariate data need every pairwise relationship and every field distribution in one linked view.

recommended_shape.summary: A dedicated 'scatter-matrix' chart definition with fields[] of any type, cell kinds per region and pair type, optional colorField, and filters. Every cell uses its fields' shared axes (continuous for numeric and date, bands with jitter for categorical and boolean); cell kinds only change drawing, so one brush and dimming rule covers all cells. One canvas draws point cells with a cached context layer; SVG draws the rest.
provisional_choices: per-pair-type defaults: numeric scatter/correlation, mixed jitter/box, categorical stacked bars/count tiles
box plots ignore group color in first release

success_moves: Make every cell share its two fields' axes and let cell kinds only change drawing, so brushing, dimming, domains, and trace work identically for scatter, box, tile, and bar cells.
Model the matrix as one chart definition following ParallelCoordinates so saved layouts, crossfilter live IDs, and own-filter dimming come from existing paths.
Reuse scatter band axes, deterministic jitter, band-aware brushFilters, pairedStats, marginalPlan stacking, and boxPlotCalculations inside a pure planScatterMatrix planner tested on penguins.
Prove points-in-every-cell across types before adding intentional categorical cells.
Render point cells on one canvas with a cached context layer, and benchmark the worst case at 10 × 100k including mixed fields with per-brush box recomputation.
Register as a separate view type with no ScatterPlot changes; hide by removing the add-chart entry.

first_proof.question: Does the shared-axis matrix work across data types with consistent dimming and responsive brushing?
first_proof.artifact: Penguins matrix with bill length, body mass, species, and sex (points, box, tiles, bars; histogram and bar diagonals), plus timings at 10k/100k × 3/5/10 fields, all-numeric and half categorical.
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed when each gesture yields the expected two filters, all cell kinds dim consistently, r matches pairedStats, and brushing meets ~100 ms at 5 × 100k and stays under 500 ms at 10 × 100k; otherwise filter on release or bin cells, and fix poorly reading cell kinds before adding more.

rabbit_holes: per-cell canvases or a grid of chart cards

milestones.title: A mixed-type penguins matrix with points everywhere and linked brushing
milestones.outcome: Shared-axis planner for numeric, categorical, boolean, and date fields; points in every cell; r; histogram and bar diagonals; one brush with gray context.
milestones.proof: Planner tests (counts, r, fixed domains/bands, range/value brush filters, date fixture) and browser check at three widths; Byron judges readability.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Registered, saveable view with points-only cells.
milestones.rollback: Remove the AddChartDialog entry; keep the type and validator so saves load.
evidence: Planner tests on penguins (counts, r≈0.595, fixed domains, range/value/date-range brush filters) pass; 665 package and 87 demo tests pass.
Browser check of the penguins example: brush sets two filters, every cell dims, species bar click selects, empty click clears; screenshots at 1280, 783, 390 px.
milestones.notes: The penguins demo example and coverage entry moved into M1 so every milestone has a reproducible screen; the settings panel ships a field list early.

milestones.title: Brushing stays responsive at 100,000 rows and 10 fields
milestones.outcome: Benchmarks (all-numeric and mixed) and renderer protections.
milestones.proof: docs/scatter-matrix-performance.md; ~100 ms at 5×100k, <500 ms at 10×100k, or fallback.
milestones.rollback: Renderer-internal; revert or filter on release.
evidence: docs/scatter-matrix-performance.md: brush on a planned layout 8.9 ms at 100k × 10 mixed (from 121.6 ms full replan).
Browser drag at 100k × 10 fields, points in both triangles: 59 ms median, 110 ms p95; 100k × 5: 25 ms median. Release commit about 0.7 s, mostly workspace field statistics outside the matrix.
milestones.notes: Spike outcome: hybrid. Up to 20,000 rows linked charts filter live; above it the matrix previews during drag and commits on release. Small points paint into a pixel count buffer.

milestones.title: Intentional cells for categorical pairs
milestones.outcome: Box plots, count tiles, stacked bars on shared axes; click-to-select; per-region per-pair-type kinds; jitter width; 12-category cap with Other.
milestones.proof: Cell planner tests, high-cardinality fixture, benchmark rerun with box cells.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Penguins shows all cell kinds dimming consistently.
milestones.rollback: New kinds are optional settings; defaults fall back to points.
evidence: Tests: box groups match penguin species counts (151, 68, 123), Tukey stats, tile pair counts and selection, Other folding selects all folded values, jitter 0 stacks bands; 670 package and 87 demo tests pass.
Browser: box click selects a species, tile click selects a species and sex pair; 100k × 10 mixed brush 64 ms median, 84 ms p95.
milestones.notes: Category pairs use count tiles (upper) and share bars (lower) instead of stacked bars: shares keep each pair on the shared axes, so brushing and dimming need no new rules.
